defect.spoken: הֵחֵלּוּ (final syllable heard as closed -lu, not -lāh)
defect.note: Human-reported and independently verified on the hash-bound original: the word's final syllable is heard as -לוּ (isolated-syllable listening: 'lu', not 'ah'). הֵחֵלָּה is the only occurrence of this word form in the Tanakh, so no same-word donor exists.

original.preserved: archival original and hash unchanged; the edition is a separate artifact

edition.encoder: libmp3lame, 48 kbps, mono, 44100 Hz (same parameters as the original)
edition.note: Full-length corrected edition derived from the verified original. One additional MP3 encode generation applies to the whole file; the archival original is untouched and remains the source of record.

target.content: the defective final syllable -לּוּ of הֵחֵלּוּ (הֵחֵ- onset preserved)

donor.context: עָלָה in the same verse (pasuk 40: וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כְלִיל־הָעִיר); same voice, same vowel, same recording

edits.method: PCM-domain splice at 44100 Hz with 15 ms raised-cosine crossfades at both joints, then a single re-encode at the original bitrate

verification: Edition SHA-256 bound above; original SHA-256 verified against the published S3 object before editing.
Isolated donor syllable listened to directly before splicing: heard as -לָה ('ah'); isolated original syllable heard as -לוּ ('oo').
Isolated corrected syllable after splicing: heard as -לָה.

Whole pasuk 40 of the edition listened to end to end: 'וְהַמַּשְׂאֵת הֵחֵלָּה לַעֲלוֹת מִן־הָעִיר עַמּוּד עָשָׁן וַיִּפֶן בִּנְיָמִן אַחֲרָיו וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כְלִיל־הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָיְמָה' — canonical, no remnant of -לוּ, no audible splice artifact.
Spectral check: the defective syllable's second formant sat ~1000-1200 Hz; the replacement carries the donor's clear 'a' vowel (F2 ~1300 Hz).
Joint-continuity measured: peak/RMS across both splice joints matches surrounding speech (no clicks).
remaining: Rerun the unchanged full-quality original-MP3 alignment pipeline (Whisper FP32 + forced alignment) against the edition's own source hash — requires the maintainer's alignment worker.
Complete canonical/timing validation, then normal website/native source, playback and packaging verification before publication.
Upload the edition to the recordings bucket under its edition name only after acceptance; do not overwrite the archival object.
